headline: Teenage Engineering launches its first CD player
summary: Teenage Engineering announced its first CD player, the EP/BC-1, which exposes the spinning disc rather than hiding it, as the start of a new $329 "broadcast" product line.

claims.statement: Teenage Engineering announced its first CD player, the EP/BC-1, which leaves the spinning disc exposed.

sources.quote: Teenage Engineering’s first CD player puts the spinning disc on display
Teenage Engineering's first CD player kind of looks like a turntable

claims.statement: The EP/BC-1 is the first product in a new "broadcast" audio line.

sources.quote: the EP/BC-1 is the first entry in its new broadcast series
marks the start of a new line of "broadcast" audio equipment.
